label: Google Flights Scraper
title: Google Flights Scraper: Live Fares, Booking & Explore
metaDescription: Scrape live Google Flights fares from a link or a form: booking options with seller links, fare names, bag fees, return flights and the price graph.
intro: Paste a Google Flights link or fill the form (city, country or airport, with every filter) and get live fares: booking options with seller links, fare names and bag fees, return flights, the price graph and Google Explore's cheapest destinations.
useCases: Track fares on a route and alert on drops
Compare booking sites for the same flight
Find the cheapest destinations from an airport

faq.q: Is there an official Google Flights API?
faq.a: No. Google shut down QPX Express in 2018 and offers no public Google Flights API. This actor returns what Google Flights shows for your search, one row per flight option.

faq.q: How do I scrape Google Flights without code?
faq.a: Search on Google Flights, copy the link from the address bar (it contains tfs=) and paste it as the input; or fill origin, destination and dates in the form. Press Start and download JSON, CSV or Excel.
One way, round trip and multi-city, every cabin class, travellers and filters, in any currency and market. A Google Explore link returns the cheapest destinations, one row per destination.

faq.q: Does it return the total price?
faq.a: Yes: the total price for all travellers in your currency, plus every segment, airline, aircraft, duration, stops and CO2. Booking options, return flights and the price graph can be added.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Google Flights API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input works in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: Google Flights search link
liveDemo.hint: Search on Google Flights, copy the link from the address bar (it contains tfs=) and press Run: the demo fetches the first flights live (up to 10).

officialApi: Google closed its only flight search API (QPX Express) in 2018 and Google Flights has no public API. This actor reads the same results Google Flights shows for a link or a route, with the real total price.
